# HomeProX

> HomeProX is a premier pest and cockroach control products brand in India. We offer powerful insect control solutions including the KILL-IT Anti Roach Spray (instant knockdown action with deep crevice reach) and KILL-IT+ Anti Roach Gel.

- [Shop Products](https://homeprox.in/shop): Complete catalog of insect and cockroach control sprays, gels, and treatments.
- [About HomeProX](https://homeprox.in/about): About our mission, technology, and home protection philosophy.
- [Blog & Pest Guides](https://homeprox.in/blog): Expert tips, usage guides, and prevention techniques against cockroach infestations.
- [Customer Support](https://homeprox.in/support): Frequently asked questions, support contacts, and order assistance.

## Key Products

- [KILL-IT Anti Roach Spray 250ml](https://homeprox.in/product?slug=kill-it-anti-roach-spray-250-ml-1): Fast-acting cockroach spray with targeted nozzle for deep crevices and barrier defense.
- [KILL-IT+ Anti Roach Gel](https://homeprox.in/product?slug=kill-it-anti-roach-gel): Odorless bait gel providing chain-kill eradication of cockroach nests.
